limits: Only the two revised pages were checked at 1440px light and 390px dark; one historical path regression ran against the same build.
Every chapter was actually clicked and followed by brief muted playback. All subtitle text and timing were checked against the frozen storyboard, with zero active captions at three Java card samples.
The Java card was decoded and paused in the browser for a 1920x1080 frame capture. Capturing screenshots alone does not claim visual inspection; actual viewed images are recorded separately.
This is not full narration listening, ASR, a learning experiment, user approval, or production Release verification.
